name: MujinaControl-S19
notes: On-board WiFi design, reviewed for manufacturing 2026-11-14 (.backplane/review.md). The order must tell the fab three things: (1) about 380 vias sit in pads and need epoxy filling with copper capping; (2) controlled-impedance six-layer build-up with 0.0994 mm prepreg between each outer layer and its ground plane (antenna line 50 ohm at 0.18 mm, USB 90 ohm, Ethernet 100 ohm); (3) standard assembly, top side only (RV1106G2 is not available in economic assembly). Board: 330 footprints including three 1 mm fiducials, 2236 tracks, 852 vias all 0.45/0.30 mm, minimum track and gap 0.127 mm, silkscreen lines 0.15 mm or wider. Exposed ground strips (no solder mask, ENIG) run along the left and right edges on top and bottom, 3.7 mm wide measured from the outermost edge, for contact with the case slots; the copper stops 0.3 mm short of the board edge and the edge walls are not plated, so no edge-plating option is needed. DRC with schematic parity 0 violations, 0 unconnected, 0 parity issues; ERC 0. Parts: 295 placements per board in 68 part numbers (26 basic, 9 preferred, 33 extended), every one with MPN and fab part number. Not fitted: J15 (2x7 accessory header), all eight fan connectors J6-J9 and J11-J14 (one option per channel is soldered in by hand), option resistors, antenna-matching positions C326/C328. Test points, mounting pads and fiducials are not in the parts list. Q1 is Vishay SiSS27DN-T1-GE3 (C506609, 7,565 in stock) on unchanged lands, replacing a part with 7 in stock; 5.6 mOhm max instead of 3.8, about 1.6 W hot at 14 A: measure its temperature on the first boards (docs/q1-upgrade.md). Stock to watch: hashboard connectors J3-J5 (29 for the 15 needed), J1 (471), RV1106G2 (762). Manufacturing files: tools/export_fab.sh writes them to mfg/MujinaControl-S19 (docs/manufacturing-files.md). The placement file is corrected for the fab's library footprints by pad comparison (26 fitted part numbers); still check polarity in the fab's placement preview. Paste openings were removed from the through-hole connector pads. Unproven on this first build: the AP6212 footprint (drawn from the datasheet) and the module's buck inductor/capacitor values L211/C323 (from a sibling module's reference schematic). Fan and WiFi control lines are auto-routed, long, with up to 8 layer changes (cosmetic). Antenna connector J19 sits south of the module, 13 mm from the east edge; the WiFi crystal Y102 is 5-7 mm from that edge: check against the case slots. The Ethernet jack J100 is the tab-up HanRun HR915340A (C2760325, 6,517 in stock; new footprint from the datasheet, unbuilt) and overhangs the bottom board edge by 2.25 mm (a through-hole part that extends past the outline). Outline redrawn 2026-11-17 from the reference outline (same 110 x 100 mm box, notches 2.6 mm deep). Five plated, grounded mounting pads: H1-H4 with 3.0 mm holes and H5 with a 3.5 mm hole east of the Ethernet jack (docs/edge-ground-strips.md). Six-layer nominal 1.6 mm, ENIG, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner. Reference designators are hidden on silkscreen; RESET and BOOT labels and the badger logo remain.
